exposure: Peripartum hemorrhage risk assessment score (AWHONN score)
Individual factors comprising the AWHONN score
cohort: The study included 3,657 patients who underwent term vaginal and cesarean deliveries at a public hospital in New York City.
finding: Medium-risk and high-risk AWHONN scores were associated with significantly higher QBL and increased odds for postpartum hemorrhage compared to low-risk scores.
